comboLegend.title: Combo colour
comboLegend.note: The number in the HUD is the combo. It is wiped after 4 placements in a row with no clear, and every miss drains the colour one step:
comboLegend.off: No combo, or the streak was broken
comboLegend.miss3: 3rd miss - one more and the combo is gone

blockblast.desc: An 8x8 board and three pieces at a time: drag them in, fill a row or a column to clear it. No timer - you lose only when nothing fits.

flag.easyTip: --easy-mode: more long bars and big squares

blockblast.flagEasy: Gentle pieces: only straight lines and squares (no corners) - and the long bars and big squares show up far more often, so filling a line and chaining combos is much easier.
blockblast.flagRollback: Adds the Undo button (key U, pad undo) that takes back the last placement, score included.
blockblast.flagsTitle: Command-line flags - click a switch below, same as adding it to play blockblast.

keys.drag: drag a piece from the tray

blockblast.title: Block Blast

funcball.againHint: Press Start duel to run again with these settings - hold Restart to go back and edit them
funcball.desc: Two function balls, one brick wall. Set f(x) on each side - factorial, percent change, a power, Fibonacci or your own - and watch every bounce turn into damage.
funcball.flagEasy: Flat wall: every layer keeps the same HP, with no per-layer multiplier.
funcball.flagSlow: Doubles the bounce height, so every bounce is slower and the damage numbers are easier to read.
funcball.flagsTitle: Command-line flags - click to switch them here, or pass them to play funcball.

legend.note: Both balls always bounce to exactly the same height - the slider above changes it for both sides at once. Every bounce is one hit:
legend.rule1: The first hit uses the starting x, so x! deals 0! = 1 damage; after every hit x grows by the step you set.
legend.rule2: Every layer multiplies its HP, and a brick only disappears once its HP is below 0 - then the ball falls on to the next layer.
legend.rule3: The first ball to break through every layer and touch the floor wins. The duel stops the moment that happens.
legend.title: How a bounce becomes damage

funcball.overDamage: A: {a} damage in {an} hits . B: {b} damage in {bn} hits
funcball.pausedHint: Press P or Esc to resume - hold Restart to go back and edit the setup
funcball.readyHint: Set both functions, then press Start duel
funcball.title: Function Ball Breaker
funcball.wallNote: A brick breaks only when its HP drops below 0 - a hit that lands exactly on 0 leaves it standing. Overkill is not carried over.
funcball.wallTitle: Brick wall - shared by both sides

games.heading: Games
games.subtitle: Small games that run right in the page. No download, no plugin - and the terminal can start them too.

tetris.desc: Seven shapes, ten columns, and a level curve that speeds up every ten lines. Ghost piece and hold included.

flag.freeTip: --free-mode: the seed decides the piece sequence (same seed, same game)
flag.hardTip: --hard-mode: constant one-third speed + garbage layers, no easy mode, no undo

tetris.flagEasy: No speed-up: the level stays at 1, the fall interval is a constant 800ms, and I / T pieces come up a bit more often.
tetris.flagFree: Free mode: the seed decides the piece sequence — same seed, same game. Adds a seed box and shareable save codes.
tetris.flagHard: Hard mode: garbage layers at the bottom (2-5 gaps per layer, placed at random and never on a column the layer below left empty), and blocks fall constantly at one third of the top speed. No easy mode, no undo.
tetris.flagRollback: Adds the Undo button (key U, pad undo) that takes back the last piece.
tetris.flagsTitle: Command-line flags - click a switch below, same as adding it to play tetris.
tetris.hardRowsHint: Each layer keeps 2-5 gaps placed at random (they may sit next to each other), but never on a column the layer below already left empty — so one vertical piece cannot fill two layers at once. The count applies from the next board on.
tetris.msgCopied: Save code copied to the clipboard.
tetris.msgCopyFail: Copy failed — the code is selected, press Ctrl/Cmd+C.
tetris.msgCopyHint: The code is in the box — copy it by hand.
tetris.msgCodeBad: That save code is not valid.
tetris.msgLoaded: Browser save loaded — press Load save code to apply it.
tetris.msgNoSave: No save in this browser yet.
tetris.msgSaveFail: This browser refused to keep it.
tetris.msgSeedBad: The seed must be a whole number.
tetris.saveHint: The code carries the seed, the board and every piece in play — copy it to share a run, or paste one here and press Load save code to carry on from it.
tetris.savePanelTitle: Save code — copy it to share, or paste one and load it
tetris.seedHint: Any whole number from -2147483648 to 2147483647. Outside that range it is clamped to the nearest end; anything that is not a whole number is refused. Same seed → same piece sequence.
tetris.title: Tetris
